title: The fact load spills 186 GB to tempdb
prompt: Client: Harbourline Commerce, a multi-tenant retail order platform with about 400 tenants. Database hlc-orders-prod: Azure SQL Database, Business Critical, Gen5, 16 vCores, compatibility level 160, READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON. All times are UTC. Business hours are 07:30 to 18:00. The nightly batch must finish by 06:00. Evidence was collected from Mon 21 Sep to Sun 27 Sep 2026.
Batch step 2, etl.LoadFactSales, took 58 minutes in August and takes 2 hours 40 minutes to 3 hours 5 minutes now. It
aggregates the nightly staging rows (10.8M in August, about 22.4M since tenant 'MegaMart' was onboarded) into

Client change log: 2025-03-11 a developer added OPTION (MAX_GRANT_PERCENT = 5) to etl.LoadFactSales, then a daytime job. 2026-01-20 etl.LoadFactSales moved into the nightly pipeline. 2026-08-30 release 5.2: ORM upgrade from version 7 to 8, new ProductSearch endpoint. 2026-09-01 tenant 'MegaMart' onboarded; nightly volume about doubled. 2026-09-04 the nightly index job was changed: rebuild threshold 30% to 5%, reorganize removed, ONLINE = ON, MAXDOP = 0, and UPDATE STATISTICS WITH FULLSCAN on every user table added. 2026-09-16 hotfix 5.2.3: an outer retry policy on every database call and Max Pool Size 100 to 400. 2026-09-24 11:47 planned maintenance reconfiguration, completed 11:48.
Name the root cause of the spill.

result.statement: INSERT INTO dw.FactSales (...) SELECT ... FROM stg.SalesDelta AS s JOIN dw.DimProduct AS p ON p.ProductId = s.ProductId GROUP BY s.SaleDate, s.StoreId, s.ProductId, s.TenantId OPTION (MAX_GRANT_PERCENT = 5)

required_facts.description: The query was granted 2,918 MB and its ideal grant is 9,830 MB.
required_facts.example: The load was granted 2,918 MB against an ideal grant of 9,830 MB, and it used all of it.

required_facts.description: About 54,000 MB of grant memory was free and no query was waiting.
required_facts.example: The grant semaphore had about 54,000 MB available and 0 waiters.

required_facts.description: Estimated and actual rows agree: 22.1M against 22.4M.
required_facts.example: The estimate is accurate: 22.1M rows estimated against 22.4M actual.

harmful_conclusions.description: The estimates are within 2%. Statistics are not the problem, and a FULLSCAN adds to the log load.
harmful_conclusions.example: Run UPDATE STATISTICS WITH FULLSCAN on stg.SalesDelta before the load.

harmful_conclusions.description: Five percent of a pool one and a half times as large is about 4.4 GB: still under the 9.8 GB the query needs.
harmful_conclusions.example: Scale up to 24 vCores for the extra memory.

harmful_conclusions.description: MIN_GRANT_PERCENT cannot raise a grant above the MAX_GRANT_PERCENT cap.
tempdb is at most 47% used and each IO is fast. The spill is the cause of the tempdb work, not the result.
